name: my-safe-mcp-server
description: A well-configured MCP server for reading and summarizing documents.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Reads a document from the allowed documents directory and returns its text content.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative path to the document within the allowed documents directory

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Lists all available documents in the allowed documents directory.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Searches for documents containing a specific keyword or phrase.

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: The keyword or phrase to look for across document contents

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)
